title: Mastermind with Deterministic Scoring and Replay

sessions.title: Seeded game + board scaffold
sessions.goal: Create and fetch a game by seed, submit and persist a guess, and render the guess row on the board.

criteria.check: POST /api/games returns 201 with a JSON Game that echoes the provided seed and a non-empty id
POST /api/games/:id/guesses with body { code: [0,1,2,3] } returns 201 JSON Guess whose code equals the body and black/white are null
On sc-play after one submission the page renders exactly 1 guess row and shows 4 peg slots reflecting the chosen colours

cuts.hint: Insert a new Game with the provided numeric `seed`, set `body` to the created { id, seed }, and set `status` to 201
Persist a Guess row for the game id from the path using the request's 4-number `code`, leaving its black/white null, then place the saved guess into `body` and set `status` to 201
Append the just-submitted 4-number code to `guessesState` so a new guess row appears on the board

sessions.title: Exact and colour-only scoring
sessions.goal: Implement Mastermind scoring and return per-row black/white pegs, rendered on the board.

criteria.check: GET /api/games/:id returns 200 with JSON { id, seed, guesses: [] } for a new game
POST /api/games/:id/guesses with a guess equal to the secret returns 201 with black = 4 and white = 0 in JSON Guess
For a permuted-all-colours guess, POST /api/games/:id/guesses returns black = 0 and white = 4
GET /api/games/:id returns 200 with guesses[] items carrying numeric black and white fields
On sc-play each rendered guess row shows its black (data-testid=score-black) and white (data-testid=score-white) counts matching the API

cuts.hint: Count exact matches into `black` by comparing secret and guess at the same index for all 4 slots
Count colour-only matches into `white` without double counting: for each colour 0..5, add the minimum of its frequency in secret and in guess, then subtract `black`
After loading the Game's secret from its seed, compute the guess's black/white using the scoring function, assign the result to `score`, and include those numbers when saving and in the response
Build `rows` from the saved guesses so each row renders the 4 pegs and shows the row's black and white counts in their testids

sessions.title: Deterministic hint and remaining candidates
sessions.goal: Show the count of candidates consistent with the history and a deterministic next guess.

criteria.check: GET /api/games/:id/hint with no guesses returns 200 with remaining = 1296 and suggestion = [0,0,0,0]
After one recorded guess, GET /api/games/:id/hint returns a remaining count matching the set consistent with that history
On sc-play the page shows hint remaining and a suggested 4-number guess
Two games with identical guess histories produce the same suggestion from GET /api/games/:id/hint

cuts.hint: From the 6^4 search space, keep only those codes in `candidates` whose score against each recorded guess equals that guess's stored black/white
Choose the deterministic next guess as the lexicographically first code from the candidate set and assign it to `suggestion`, or null when the set is empty
Load the game's guesses, compute the remaining candidate set and a deterministic next guess, and place { remaining, suggestion } into `body` with status 200
Fetch the hint endpoint for the active game and write its { remaining, suggestion } into `hintState` for display

sessions.title: Replay, list, resume, and branch
sessions.goal: List saved games, resume any game, and branch a new game from any earlier turn.

criteria.check: GET /api/games returns 200 with an array of { id, seed, guessCount }
On /games the list renders one row per saved game (data-testid=game-row) showing its id and guessCount
Clicking Resume for a saved game shows the board with the correct number of guess rows for that game
POST /api/games/:id/branch with body { upto: k } returns 201 with a new Game; GET that id shows exactly k guesses copied
On sc-play, after clicking the Branch Here button for row k, the page renders exactly k guess rows (elements with data-testid^=guess-row-)

cuts.hint: Read all games with their guess counts and assign an array of { id, seed, guessCount } to `body` with status 200
Fetch the games index and write the received array into `gamesState` so one row renders per game
On a Resume button click, set `currentGameId` to that game's id and navigate to the board so its guesses load
Create a new Game with the same seed as the source, copy the first `upto` guesses into it (including black/white), place the new { id, seed } into `body` and set `status` to 201
After Branch Here is clicked for row k, call the branch endpoint and set `currentGameId` to the returned game's id so the board reloads to k rows
